cat > analyze.py <<'PY'
import socket,sys,time
import arena
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX);s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock');f=s.makefile('r')
def send(x):s.sendall((x+'\n').encode())
send('uci')
while 'uciok' not in f.readline():pass
send('setoption name Threads value 2');send('setoption name Hash value 256');send('isready')
while 'readyok' not in f.readline():pass
b=arena.load_board()
if len(sys.argv)>2:
 for m in sys.argv[2:]:b.push_uci(m)
send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
send('go movetime '+str(int(float(sys.argv[1])*1000)))
for line in f:
 if 'depth' in line or 'bestmove' in line: print(line.strip(),flush=True)
 if line.startswith('bestmove'):break
send('quit')
PY
